initial.subject: Welcome to Couchers.org and the future of couch surfing
initial.welcome: Welcome to Couchers.org, and our growing worldwide community of couch surfers. We are excited that you have joined us!
initial.early_user_role: We are still a small platform and are growing quickly. As an early user, you have a vital role in shaping the future of the platform. You can help us set the scene and culture as we grow bigger, as well as test functionality and provide feedback as we develop new features.
initial.fill_in_profile: Please take some time to explore the platform. As a first step, please write a bit about yourself on your profile. Please upload a photo and fill in some profile text, you can even copy your description from your account on other platforms if you're feeling lazy :P
initial.edit_profile_prompt: To edit your profile, click on the following link:
initial.share_with_friends: Otherwise, please share the link with any of your couch surfing friends that you trust! This platform can only grow with your help bringing the best people to it.
initial.platform_under_development: The platform is still under development, and features are actively being built by our amazing team of Couchers.org contributors around the world. We would like to hear your feedback and thoughts on what we've built and what we're working on.
initial.thanks_for_joining: Thanks so much for joining the platform. We're really excited to have you here and as part of our growing community!
initial.signature:
Aapeli
Couchers.org Co-founder
aapeli@couchers.org (feel free to shoot me an email at any time)

https://couchers.org/user/aapeli

follow_up.subject: Complete your profile on Couchers.org
follow_up.intro: I hope you've taken a bit of time to look around the Couchers.org platform!
follow_up.fill_in_profile: We would love to ask one quick favor of you: please take a moment to fill out your profile by adding a photo and some text.
follow_up.no_empty_accounts: A big problem that some platforms have is that there are so many empty accounts, and we really want to avoid that!
follow_up.profile_importance: We would really appreciate it if you could add a photo and fill in at least the "Who I am" section of your profile, although a full profile would be even better! It's an easy way to help showcase the amazing community we're building together, and it means you'll be fully ready to connect, host, or surf as the community thrives.

received.subject: You've received a reference from {{name}}!
received.view_action: View the reference on your profile
received.reciprocate_encouragement: Please go and write a reference for them too. It's a nice gesture and helps us build a community together! When you've both written a reference, both references will become visible. Otherwise {{name}}'s reference will become visible 2 weeks after the end of your interaction, after which you cannot write a reference back.

reminder.importance_note: Your reference is vital to keeping the community safe, trustworthy, and welcoming. By writing honestly and in detail about your experience with this person, you will directly help other members and contribute to safety and trust in the Couchers community.
reminder.no_meeting_note: If you didn't end up meeting {{name}}, please use the reference flow to let us know (and we'll stop reminding you to write a reference).
reminder.via_messaging_note: You can also leave a reference by going to the Messaging tab, locating the request, then clicking on the "Write Reference" button at the bottom of the conversation.
reminder.visibility_note: References will become visible 2 weeks after the stay, or when you've both written a reference for each other, whichever comes sooner.
